project.title: Integrated metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing of wastewater samples across wastewater treatment stages
project.description: Integrated metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing of wastewater samples collected at different treatment stages from six municipal wastewater treatment plants across the United States.
